svg.title: Dufferin Terrace: a masonry parapet with an ornate cast-iron railing along its head, a rhythm of green lamp standards with white globe lamps, one plain open timber shelter - GENERIC, and it is a correction: it was a striped bandstand kiosk with a green-and-white radial roof and a white finial, and an unprimed verifier named Terrasse Dufferin, Quebec City off it. This tile repeats every 2016 px, so a recognisable building on it breaks this subject own neverAdd. Street furniture that is really architecture, benches, people in winter coats, and one timber footbridge over the toboggan run. The chute wall runs along the foot. Survives the low preset. GENERIC by decision: this tile repeats, so it carries no landmark. World y 700..1340; ground line at local 580.
